description: USE WHEN you want the probability that SPY, QQQ, GLD or TLT is in each market regime in 5 or 21 trading days. Model-conditional probabilities of BULL / SIDEWAYS / BEAR / CRISIS (operational trailing-vol/drift labels) after 5 or 21 trading days: stress tools answer 'what happens GIVEN regime X', this answers 'how likely is X from today's state'. Only the preregistered, out-of-sample-validated tier ships (covariate logit); persistence and unconditional baselines are reported beside it. Assets: SPY, QQQ, GLD, TLT (GOLD accepted for GLD). Optional as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) evaluates a past date. Class membership, not a market prediction, not advisory.

as_of.description: Optional historical evaluation date (YYYY-MM-DD); empty = latest data.
as_of.title: As Of

asset.description: One of the out-of-sample-validated assets: 'SPY', 'QQQ', 'GLD', 'TLT' (GOLD is read as GLD).
asset.title: Asset

horizon_days.description: Validated horizons only: 5 or 21 trading days.
horizon_days.title: Horizon Days
